q2_gaps: change-of-state copular verb with a predicate nominal ("became a lawyer and politician") — the instruction set prescribes no way to attach the resulting predicate to the reified become event, so sk_become_1 ends up with no link at all to lawyer/politician
notes: The temporal "while" correctly yields (During sk_operate_1 sk_become_1) and no connective atom, and "a lawyer" is correctly a predication on martin rather than a witness. "successful sawmill" is correctly split into kind plus descriptive property.
